comment: Dual C–N bond formation on the core peptide WNW

reactions.description: AxyP catalyzes two C–N bonds within the core motif WNW

AxyP catalyzes two separate C–N bonds, one intramolecular cross-linking (W1 to its own backbone nitrogen) and second between W1-W3 on the core motif of precursor peptide AxyA. The cross-linked mature product is Xylanisin A and B. AxyA: MLRRIFGTKPALRWNW
